user.title: Connect to Iddero
user.description: Connect to the Iddero web interface on your local network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Iddero panel.
data_description.base_path: Path where the web UI starts, normally /.
data_description.auto_discover: Scan Iddero zone pages when no device map exists.
data_description.create_areas: Automatically create Home Assistant areas matching Iddero zone names.
data_description.devices_file: Optional path to a JSON device map. Relative paths are resolved from the Home Assistant config directory.
data_description.poll_interval: How often Home Assistant should poll the page.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Iddero panel.
error.invalid_auth: The Iddero panel rejected the credentials.

abort.already_configured: This Iddero panel is already configured.
